thread:
maria: quick sync — we need to decide which audit events are customer-visible vs internal. focus areas: RBAC changes, KMS access, vuln triage actions. goal is a short list product can show + clear redaction rules. :eyes:

jordan: +1. can we start by agreeing on a naming convention for customer-facing events? e.g. `iam.role_assigned.v1` vs internal `iam.role_assign_internal.v1`

ben: for RBAC: customer-visible should include role create/update/delete and role assignment changes in their org. but sensitive fields (actor email, IP) should be redacted unless tenant opted-in.

sam: for KMS: key creation/rotation can be surfaced, but any key material access attempts (decrypt using BYOK) should be internal by default. customers can opt into key-access logs if they have BYOK and sign a data-sharing addendum. :lock:

lee: question: do we want to include `actor_type` (user/service) and `actor_id` for customer-visible? my vote: include `actor_id` (opaque UUID) and `actor_type`, but strip `actor_email` and `ip`. makes product admins actionable without exposing PII.

jordan: agreed. propose schema snippet we can publish to customers (example):

```
{
  "event_name": "iam.role_assigned.v1",
  "ts": "...",
  "tenant_id": "...",
  "actor": { "id": "uuid", "type": "user|service" },
  "target": { "id": "uuid", "type": "resource|role" },
  "meta": { "changes": "..." }
}
```

Note: no `actor_email`, no `ip`.

ben: also recommend `sensitivity` flag on events (PUBLIC | INTERNAL | RESTRICTED). that will drive tooling: masking, retention, exportability.

maria: good idea. SECURITY-ops can map `RESTRICTED` -> not exportable to customer SIEM by default.

sam: vuln triage events: `vuln.create`, `vuln.escalate` should be INTERNAL unless the customer is the affected tenant and we explicitly notify them. otherwise risk leaking vuln context.

lee: edge case: automated remediation (e.g., RBAC rollback) — customers probably want a visible event for audit. we should treat automated corrective actions as customer-visible but with `meta.remediation = true`.

jordan: compatibility note: whatever we publish must map to current event stream names in prod. I'll open a mapping PR that renames a few noisy events. linking PR when ready.

auditbot: NOTICE: created issue ENGSEC-921 "Customer-visible audit event spec & redaction rules" and attached spec draft.

maria: action items: 1) jordan to draft canonical names + prod mapping PR (due EOD Wed) 2) ben + lee to write redaction rules for PII/keys (ETA Thu) 3) sam to draft BYOK opt-in export policy 4) I'll coordinate customer doc snippet and notify Product.

ben: ack. I'll add sample SIEM mapping (Splunk/CEF) to the PR.

lee: ack. I'll run a quick audit of current events for `actor_email` leaks and post findings in the issue.

maria: thanks team. we want this in the public docs + to avoid surprises for customers. ping me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:

sam: noted, will flag any legal/contract asks if BYOK export is required.

jordan: PR #378 is up (draft) — includes initial rename list and sensitivity tagging. please review.

maria: closing thread — we'll follow on the ENGSEC-921 issue.
